context.en-US: During pheomelanogenesis the amino acid Cysteine adds to dopaquinone, forming cysteinyldopas that cyclize and oxidize into benzothiazine intermediates. context.en-US: Pheomelanin-rich melanocytes (red hair and fair skin via MC1R) carry higher melanoma risk, and the shared pheomelanic chemistry supports links between pigment phenotypes and cancer. The association is epidemiological and mechanistic rather than a proven direct causal claim.
context.zh-TW: 富含 Pheomelanin 的 melanocytes（透過 MC1R 呈現的紅髮和淺膚色）具有較高的黑色素瘤風險，而共享的 pheomelanic 化學特性支持色素表現型與癌症之間的關聯。了解 benzothiazine 成分有助於解釋色素穩定性和金屬處理的個體間差異。這種關聯是流行病學和機制性的，而不是經證實的直接因果主張。

context.en-US: Benzothiazine rings have been identified within the heterogeneous core of Neuromelanin, reflecting its mixed eumelanic and pheomelanic chemistry. Solid-state NMR and X-ray spectroscopy reveal sulfur-containing benzothiazine-like moieties alongside indolic 5,6-indolequinone-derived units. The benzothiazine content may influence neuromelanin's paramagnetic and metal-binding properties.
context.zh-TW: 在 Neuromelanin 的異質核心中已鑑定出 benzothiazine 環，反映了其混合的 eumelanic 和 pheomelanic 化學特性。固態 NMR 和 X 射線光譜揭示了含硫的 benzothiazine 樣基團，以及源自 5,6-indolequinone 的吲哚類單元。benzothiazine 含量可能影響 neuromelanin 的順磁性和金屬結合特性。

context.en-US: Benzothiazine rings are more redox-labile and more prone to generate Oxidative Stress than the indolic units of eumelanin. Pheomelanin-type structures are poorer antioxidants and can, under UV or oxidative challenge, produce damaging radicals. This pro-oxidant behavior is relevant to both skin and brain pigment biology.
context.zh-TW: 與 eumelanin 的吲哚類單元相比，benzothiazine 環更易發生氧化還原不穩定，且更容易產生 Oxidative Stress。Pheomelanin 型結構是較差的抗氧化劑，在 UV 或氧化挑戰下可能產生有害自由基。這種促氧化行為與皮膚和大腦的色素生物學都相關。

context.en-US: The benzothiazine component of neuromelanin may modulate how the pigment handles iron and redox stress, potentially affecting neuronal vulnerability in Parkinson's Disease. By catalyzing the tautomerization of dopachrome to 5,6-dihydroxyindole-2-carboxylic acid, the enzyme promotes eumelanin formation. This enzymatic step is critical for protective dark pigment production.
context.zh-TW: Dopachrome tautomerase 活性將黑色素途徑轉向富含 DHICA 的 eumelanin，與替代的吲哚途徑相比，後者更穩定且是更好的抗氧化劑。透過催化 dopachrome 異構化為 5,6-dihydroxyindole-2-carboxylic acid，該酶促進 eumelanin 的形成。此酶促步驟對於保護性深色色素的產生至關重要。

context.en-US: TRP-2 is also a melanoma antigen, linking pigment enzymes to immune recognition. This makes the enzyme relevant to tumor immunology as well as pigment biology. Its expression in melanoma has implications for immune-based therapies.

context.en-US: Tyrosinase-family enzymes and their regulators are expressed in the brain and can modulate the balance of eumelanic versus pheomelanic motifs within Neuromelanin. Aberrant or ectopic TRP-2 activity could alter pigment composition, metal binding, and redox behavior in dopaminergic neurons. DCT thus illustrates how the melanogenic toolkit is repurposed in the brain.
context.zh-TW: Tyrosinase 家族酶及其調節因子在大腦中表達，可以調節 Neuromelanin 內 eumelanic 與 pheomelanic 基序的平衡。異常或異位的 TRP-2 活性可能改變多巴胺神經元中的色素組成、金屬結合和氧化還原行為。因此 DCT 說明了黑色素生成工具包如何在大腦中被重新利用。

context.en-US: Aberrant or ectopic tyrosinase-family activity in the brain may contribute to Oxidative Stress in dopaminergic neurons. Shifts in melanogenic enzyme activity affect the redox behavior of neuromelanin. The enzyme therefore connects pigment composition to oxidative vulnerability.
context.zh-TW: 大腦中異常或異位的 tyrosinase 家族活性可能導致多巴胺神經元中的 Oxidative Stress。黑色素生成酶活性的變化影響 neuromelanin 的氧化還原行為。因此該酶將色素組成與氧化脆弱性聯繫起來。

context.en-US: In Parkinson's Disease, altered neuromelanin quality rather than quantity may reflect shifted melanogenic enzyme activity, contributing to Oxidative Stress and Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation. The enzyme is a reference point for comparing cutaneous and neural melanin.

context.en-US: TRP-2/DCT is a type I membrane glycoprotein of the melanosome, closely related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1. It requires copper at its active site and is regulated transcriptionally by MITF and post-translationally within melanosomes. The enzyme is part of the shared tyrosinase-family melanogenic toolkit.
context.zh-TW: TRP-2/DCT 是 melanosome 的 I 型膜醣蛋白，與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 密切相關。它的活性位點需要 copper，並在轉錄上受 MITF 調控，且在 melanosomes 內受到轉譯後調控。該酶是共享的 tyrosinase 家族黑色素生成工具包的一部分。

context.en-US: Dopachrome tautomerase (DDT) is the historical enzyme name for Tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP-2), also known as DCT. Both names refer to the same melanosomal enzyme. It is a type I membrane glycoprotein related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1.
context.zh-TW: Dopachrome tautomerase（DDT）是 Tyrosinase-related protein-2（TRP-2，也稱為 DCT）的歷史性酶名稱。兩個名稱指的是同一種 melanosomal 酶。它是一種與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 相關的 I 型膜醣蛋白。

context.en-US: Dopamine is biochemically converted into Dopamine o-quinone through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, Dopamine acts as the substrate and Dopamine o-quinone as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. context.en-US: MC1R is expressed on Melanocytes and controls whether they produce eumelanin or pheomelanin. Signaling through this receptor determines skin and hair color. Loss-of-function variants typical of red hair and fair skin reduce eumelanin production in melanocytes.
context.zh-TW: MC1R 在 Melanocytes 上表達，並控制它們產生 eumelanin 還是 pheomelanin。透過此受體的信號傳導決定皮膚和頭髮的顏色。典型紅髮和淺膚色的功能缺失變異會減少 melanocytes 中的 eumelanin 產生。

context.en-US: MC1R regulates the melanogenic pathway by switching Melanocytes from pheomelanin to eumelanin synthesis. Upon binding alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone, MC1R signals via Gs to stimulate adenylyl cyclase and cAMP, activating the eumelanogenic program in Melanogenesis. Loss-of-function variants reduce signaling and shift synthesis toward Pheomelanin.

context.en-US: MC1R activation can dampen Neuroinflammation and oxidative injury in the brain. The receptor is expressed on astrocytes and neurons, and its activation reduces microglial activation. Loss-of-function variants may impair this protective anti-inflammatory signaling.

context.en-US: MC1R signaling may modulate the resilience of Neuromelanin-containing neurons, since both skin and brain melanogenesis share the Tyrosinase-dependent catechol oxidation pathway. This links MC1R to brain pigment biology and dopaminergic neuron survival. Intriguingly, MC1R bridges skin and brain melanogenesis.

context.en-US: MC1R agonists such as alpha-MSH analogs and Melanocortins are being explored preclinically for Neuroprotection. They reduce microglial activation and improve mitochondrial function. MC1R signaling is therefore a therapeutic target in neurodegeneration.

context.en-US: Epidemiological studies report that MC1R variants, independent of pigmentation, associate with increased Parkinson's Disease risk and earlier age at onset. MC1R is expressed on astrocytes and neurons, and its activation can dampen neuroinflammation and oxidative injury. Red-hair variants may impair protective signaling, leaving dopaminergic neurons of the Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta more vulnerable.
context.zh-TW: 流行病學研究報告指出，MC1R 變異與色素無關，與 Parkinson's Disease 風險增加和發病年齡較早相關。MC1R 在星形膠質細胞和神經元上表達，其活化可以抑制 neuroinflammation 和氧化損傷。紅髮變異可能損害保護性信號傳導，使 Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta 的多巴胺神經元更容易受損。

context.en-US: High cAMP downstream of MC1R activation upregulates Tyrosinase and the eumelanogenic program. Tyrosinase is the rate-limiting enzyme whose induction produces protective dark pigment. MC1R signaling thereby drives Tyrosinase-dependent melanin synthesis.

context.en-US: Ventral Tegmental Area is spared in Parkinson's Disease, contrasting with the pronounced loss of other dopaminergic populations. Mechanistically, relative sparing reflects differences in pigment load, connectivity, and vulnerability factors between nuclei. This is significant because the differential involvement helps define the anatomical selectivity of the disease. A caveat is that 'spared' is relative; these neurons may show milder or later changes rather than complete immunity.

context.en-US: Vesicular Monoamine Transporter 2 transports Dopamine across a membrane, concentrating the substrate away from the cytosol. Mechanistically, the transporter uses proton or ion gradients to load the cargo into vesicles or organelles. This is significant because proper transport protects against auto-oxidation and provides the releasable pool for neurotransmission. A caveat is that transport is saturable and can be impaired, in which case cytosolic substrate becomes a source of oxidative stress.

context.en-US: Macromolecular crowding impedes vesicle and organelle diffusion, compromising autophagic flux in pigment-laden neurons. Crowding thus links pigment accumulation to degradative failure.
context.zh-TW: 大分子擁擠阻礙囊泡與胞器擴散，損害色素 laden 神經元的自噬通量。擁擠因而將色素累積與降解失敗連結。

context.en-US: Excluded-volume effects raise association constants, driving alpha-synuclein oligomerization in crowded neuronal compartments. Crowding is a biophysical catalyst of synuclein aggregation.
context.zh-TW: 排除體積效應提高結合常數，在擁擠的神經元區室驅動 alpha-synuclein 寡聚化。擁擠是 synuclein 聚集的生物物理催化劑。

context.en-US: Insoluble neuromelanin pigment substantially increases intracellular crowding in aged catecholaminergic neurons. Pigment load is a crowding source alongside organelle accumulation.
context.zh-TW: 不溶性 neuromelanin 大幅提高老化兒茶酚胺能神經元的細胞內擁擠。色素負荷與胞器累積並列為擁擠來源。

context.en-US: Crowding facilitates inclusion assembly, as modeled in vitro for Lewy body formation. Excluded volume lowers the barrier to protein deposition into inclusions.
context.zh-TW: 擁擠促進包涵體組裝，體外路易體形成模型已證實。排除體積降低蛋白沉積為包涵體的屏障。

context.en-US: The proteostasis network is challenged by excluded-volume effects that perturb folding and clearance equilibria. Crowding connects pigment load to proteostatic collapse.
context.zh-TW: 蛋白質穩態網絡受排除體積效應挑戰，擾亂折疊與清除平衡。擁擠將色素負荷與蛋白穩態崩潰連結。

context.en-US: Pigment-packed lysosomes worsen crowding and aggregation; the wording is strictly bidirectional, so association only without causal direction. Co-occurrence of granular load and lysosomal failure defines vulnerable neurons.
context.zh-TW: 色素填充的溶小體加重擁擠與聚集；措辭嚴格雙向，故僅為關聯而不帶因果方向。顆粒負荷與溶小體失敗的共現定義易損神經元。

context.en-US: TSPO radioligands visualize activated microglia, making PET the in-vivo readout of neuroinflammation. Detection parallels the MRI-detects-neuromelanin precedent.
context.zh-TW: TSPO 放射配體顯影活化的小膠質細胞，使 PET 成為神經發炎的體內讀值。偵測呼應 MRI 偵測 neuromelanin 的先例。

context.en-US: PET dopaminergic and inflammatory tracers are indispensable for Parkinson's Disease diagnosis and staging. Imaging complements clinical and histological assessment.
context.zh-TW: PET 多巴胺能與發炎追蹤劑對 Parkinson's Disease 診斷與分期不可或缺。影像補充臨床與組織學評估。

context.en-US: PET is the primary in-vivo window into nigrostriatal integrity via presynaptic dopaminergic tracers. Association records the imaging-target relationship.
context.zh-TW: PET 經由突觸前多巴胺能追蹤劑成為黑質紋狀體完整性的主要體內窗口。關聯記錄影像與標的關係。

context.en-US: VMAT2 ligands such as 18F-AV-133 are core presynaptic PET tracers of monoaminergic terminals. Association records the tracer-target pairing.
context.zh-TW: 18F-AV-133 等 VMAT2 配體是單胺能末梢的核心突觸前 PET 追蹤劑。關聯記錄追蹤劑與標的配對。

context.en-US: Proton leak is the passive return of protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane, bypassing ATP synthase. Localization defines the chemiosmotic short-circuit.
context.zh-TW: 質子漏是質子跨內粒線體膜的被動回流，繞過 ATP 合酶。定位定義化學滲透短路。

context.en-US: Proton leak dissipates the mitochondrial gradient as heat, the mechanistic basis of brown-fat thermogenesis. Uncoupling converts respiratory energy to warmth.
context.zh-TW: 質子漏以熱耗散粒線體梯度，是棕色脂肪產熱的機制基礎。去偶聯將呼吸能量轉為熱。

context.en-US: UCP1 mediates inducible proton leak across the inner membrane in brown adipose tissue. Inducible uncoupling separates heat production from ATP demand.
context.zh-TW: UCP1 在棕色脂肪組織介導可誘發的質子漏。可誘發去偶聯將產熱與 ATP 需求分離。

context.en-US: Proton leak accounts for roughly a fifth of resting oxygen consumption; as a component rather than a cause, association is the correct bucket. Leak sets basal metabolic floor.
context.zh-TW: 質子漏約佔靜息氧耗的五分之一；作為組分而非原因，關聯是正確的歸類。漏設定基礎代謝下限。

context.en-US: Muscle proton leak is partly set by UCP3 expression levels. Regulation tunes uncoupling to fiber-type energy demand.
context.zh-TW: 肌肉質子漏部分由 UCP3 表現水平設定。調節將去偶聯調至肌纖維能量需求。

context.en-US: Proton leak uncouples oxygen consumption from ATP production; as a partial physiological effect the confidence is capped. Uncoupling trades efficiency for heat and redox relief.
context.zh-TW: 質子漏將氧耗與 ATP 產生去偶聯；作為部分生理效應，信心設上限。去偶聯以效率換取熱與氧化還原緩解。

context.en-US: Skeletal muscle is a major site of leak-mediated energy expenditure. Localization marks the thermogenic tissue bed.
context.zh-TW: 骨骼肌是漏介導能量消耗的主要部位。定位標記產熱組織床。

context.en-US: SARM1 is the NAD+-consuming executor of programmed axonal destruction downstream of injury and stress. Its activation depletes axonal NAD+ and drives fragmentation.
context.zh-TW: SARM1 是損傷與壓力下游程序性軸突破壞的 NAD+ 消耗執行者。其活化耗竭軸突 NAD+ 並驅動片段化。

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside protects neurons from excitotoxicity-induced axon loss by restoring axonal NAD+. Precursor repletion counters SARM1-driven depletion.
context.zh-TW: Nicotinamide riboside 經由恢復軸突 NAD+ 保護神經元免於興奮毒性誘發的軸突缺失。前體補充對抗 SARM1 驅動的耗竭。

context.en-US: NAD+ restoration prevents axonal loss while its depletion drives degeneration. Axonal NAD+ level is the survival determinant upstream of SARM1 execution.
context.zh-TW: NAD+ 恢復防止軸突缺失，而其耗竭驅動退化。軸突 NAD+ 水平是 SARM1 執行上游的存活決定因子。

context.en-US: Excitotoxicity is a primary trigger causing axonal degeneration in part through calcium overload and energetic collapse. Overactivation converts signaling into structural destruction.
context.zh-TW: 興奮毒性是經由鈣超載與能量崩潰部分導致軸突退化的主要觸發。過度活化將訊號轉為結構破壞。

context.en-US: Parkinson's Disease features axonal degeneration of dopaminergic projections preceding somatic loss. Association records the prodromal axonopathy.
context.zh-TW: Parkinson's Disease 具多巴胺投射軸突退化，早於胞體缺失。關聯記錄前驅軸突病變。

context.en-US: Early axonal pathology accompanies Alzheimer's Disease progression. Association records shared axonopathy across neurodegenerations.
context.zh-TW: 早期軸突病理伴隨 Alzheimer's Disease 進展。關聯記錄神經退化間共享的軸突病變。

context.en-US: SIRT3 is an NAD+-dependent mitochondrial deacetylase; raising mitochondrial NAD+ supports its activity. Cofactor supply gates sirtuin function.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 是 NAD+ 依賴的粒線體去乙醯化酶；提高粒線體 NAD+ 支持其活性。輔因子供應門控 sirtuin 功能。

context.en-US: Retinal photoreceptors pack mitochondria densely to meet phototransduction energy demand. Containment records the organelle-rich anatomy.
context.zh-TW: 視網膜感光細胞密集填充粒線體以滿足光轉導能量需求。包含記錄富胞器的解剖。

context.en-US: Nicotinamide riboside is the precursor restoring mitochondrial NAD+ through salvage synthesis. Precursor-to-cofactor conversion parallels the L-DOPA-to-dopamine precedent.
context.zh-TW: Nicotinamide riboside 是經由挽救合成恢復粒線體 NAD+ 的前體。前體到輔因子轉化呼應 L-DOPA 到多巴胺的先例。

context.en-US: SIRT3 supports mitochondrial ROS detoxification systems, defending against oxidative stress. Deacetylase-driven antioxidant support parallels the ascorbic acid precedent.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 支持粒線體 ROS 解毒系統，防禦氧化壓力。去乙醯化酶驅動的抗氧化支持呼應抗壞血酸先例。

context.en-US: Diabetic retinopathy degeneration is linked to retinal NAD+ loss in photoreceptors. Association records the metabolic retinopathy connection.
context.zh-TW: 糖尿病視網膜病變退化與感光細胞視網膜 NAD+ 缺失相關。關聯記錄代謝性視網膜病變連結。

context.en-US: SIRT3 governs photoreceptor ATP and ROS homeostasis as a core review finding. Regulation is the metabolic control relationship.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 作為核心回顧發現掌管感光細胞 ATP 與 ROS 恆定。調節是代謝控制關係。

context.en-US: Diazepam increases GABA-A chloride-channel opening frequency, potentiating fast inhibitory neurotransmission. Modulation is the allosteric enhancement relationship.
context.zh-TW: Diazepam 提高 GABA-A 氯通道開放頻率，增強快速抑制性神經傳導。調節是變構增強關係。

context.en-US: Age-related glomerular filtration decline drives systemic advanced glycation end-product accumulation, with serum CML correlating negatively with filtration and positively with age. Association records the renal aging axis.
context.zh-TW: 年齡相關的腎絲球過濾下降驅動全身晚期糖化終產物累積，血清 CML 與過濾負相關、與年齡正相關。關聯記錄腎臟老化軸。

context.en-US: The chloroacetaldehyde metabolite interferes with mitochondrial respiration, and methylene blue rescue is attributed to restoring mitochondrial function. Association is capped as borderline mechanistic evidence.
context.zh-TW: 氯乙醛代謝物干擾粒線體呼吸，而亞甲藍救援歸因於恢復粒線體功能。關聯因機制證據邊緣而設上限。

context.en-US: Acoustic trauma generates reactive oxygen species driving cochlear hair-cell death; nicotinamide riboside prevents loss via SIRT3 antioxidant support. Oxidative injury is the pathogenic trigger.
context.zh-TW: 聲創傷產生超量活性氧驅動耳蝸毛細胞死亡；nicotinamide riboside 經 SIRT3 抗氧化支持防止缺失。氧化損傷是致病觸發。

context.en-US: Oxidative stress is a stated pro-arrhythmic driver, with resveratrol's anti-arrhythmic effect attributed partly to antioxidant action. Redox injury destabilizes cardiac electrophysiology.
context.zh-TW: 氧化壓力是既定的促心律失常驅動，resveratrol 的抗心律失常效應部分歸因於抗氧化作用。氧化還原損傷破壞心臟電生理穩定。

context.en-US: HPP+ accumulates in mitochondria via dopamine transporter uptake and inhibits complex I of the electron transport chain, mirroring MPP+ toxicity. Complex I blockade drives oxidative injury in nigral neurons.
context.zh-TW: HPP+ 經多巴胺轉運蛋白攝取累積於粒線體，抑制電子傳遞鏈複合體 I，呼應 MPP+ 毒性。複合體 I 阻斷驅動黑質神經元氧化損傷。

context.en-US: HPP+ neurotoxicity produces a parkinsonian phenotype mimicking Parkinson's Disease without causing idiopathic disease. Association records the model relationship, weaker than causation.
context.zh-TW: HPP+ 神經毒性產生模仿 Parkinson's Disease 的帕金森表型，而非導致特發性疾病。關聯記錄模型關係，弱於因果。

context.en-US: Eumelanin binds iron within neuromelanin granules, contributing to metal sequestration. Binding parallels the neuromelanin-iron chelation axis.
context.zh-TW: Eumelanin 在 neuromelanin 顆粒內結合鐵，促成金屬隔離。結合呼應 neuromelanin-鐵螯合軸。

context.en-US: Tyrosinase is the rate-limiting enzyme of eumelanin biosynthesis, paralleling the dopachrome tautomerase produces Eumelanin edge. Enzymatic oxidation initiates dark-pigment polymerization.
context.zh-TW: Tyrosinase 是 eumelanin 生物合成的限速酶，與 dopachrome tautomerase 產生 Eumelanin 邊平行。酶促氧化啟動深色素聚合。

context.en-US: Dolichol resides within neuromelanin pigment granules of the substantia nigra pars compacta. Presence records the isoprenoid component of granule matrix.
context.zh-TW: Dolichol 存在於黑質緻密部 neuromelanin 色素顆粒內。存在記錄顆粒基質的異戊二烯成分。

context.en-US: Dopamine governs striatal synaptic plasticity as a neuromodulator of strength changes. Regulation is the modulatory control relationship.
context.zh-TW: 多巴胺作為強度變化的神經調節劑掌管紋狀體突觸可塑性。調節是調節性控制關係。

context.en-US: TRP-2 directs eumelanin synthesis as a dopachrome tautomerase family enzyme, paralleling the DCT production edge under its alias subject. Enzymatic activity channels pigment toward dark polymer.
context.zh-TW: TRP-2 作為 dopachrome tautomerase 家族酶指導 eumelanin 合成，在其別名主詞下與 DCT 產生邊平行。酶活性將色素導向深色聚合物。
